name: Proton transfer reactions benchmark
description: A benchmark suite assessing approximate quantum chemical and machine-learned potentials on biochemical proton transfer reaction energetics and pathways.
evaluation_method: MAE/RMSE on predicted energies and barrier heights (kcal/mol); force RMSE (kcal·mol⁻¹·Å⁻¹); pathway similarity / transition-state identification metrics
typical_sota_score: approximately 0.5–2.0 kcal/mol MAE on energies for top ML potentials (dataset- and method-dependent)
reputation: Used in computational-chemistry and ML-for-chemistry studies to evaluate approximate quantum methods and ML potentials on proton-transfer energetics and pathways.
notes: Benchmark performance depends strongly on reference electronic-structure level and sampling; dataset size is limited and chemically focused (proton transfer), so transferability can be limited; not an LLM benchmark.
